<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { OrbitControls } from 'three/addons/controls/OrbitControls.js';

const TEX = 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/mrdoob/three.js@r160/examples/textures/planets/';

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- scene setup
const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true });
renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(devicePixelRatio, 2));
renderer.setSize(innerWidth, innerHeight);
renderer.outputColorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

const scene = new THREE.Scene();
scene.background = new THREE.Color(0x000000);

const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(38, innerWidth / innerHeight, 0.1, 2000);
camera.position.set(0, 0.9, 4.2);

const controls = new OrbitControls(camera, renderer.domElement);
controls.enableDamping = true;
controls.dampingFactor = 0.06;
controls.rotateSpeed = 0.45;
controls.minDistance = 1.6;
controls.maxDistance = 12;
controls.enablePan = false;

// ------------------------------------------------------------------- lighting
scene.add(new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff, 0.06));

const sun = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xfff4e8, 2.6);
sun.position.set(5, 2, 3);
scene.add(sun);

// cool bounce light so the night side reads as a silhouette, not a void
const fill = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0x2a4a7a, 0.35);
fill.position.set(-4, -1, -3);
scene.add(fill);

// ------------------------------------------------------------------- textures
const loader = new THREE.TextureLoader();
loader.setCrossOrigin('anonymous');

function load(file, colorSpace, onFail) {
  return loader.load(
    TEX + file,
    t => { if (colorSpace) t.colorSpace = colorSpace; },
    undefined,
    () => onFail && onFail()
  );
}

// Offline fallback: paint a plausible world on a canvas with value noise, so
// the globe still looks like a globe when the texture CDN is unreachable.
function proceduralEarth() {
  const w = 1024, h = 512;
  const c = document.createElement('canvas');
  c.width = w; c.height = h;
  const ctx = c.getContext('2d');

  const ocean = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, h);
  ocean.addColorStop(0.00, '#0b2a4a');
  ocean.addColorStop(0.50, '#10406e');
  ocean.addColorStop(1.00, '#0b2a4a');
  ctx.fillStyle = ocean;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);

  const perm = new Uint8Array(512);
  for (let i = 0; i < 256; i++) perm[i] = i;
  for (let i = 255; i > 0; i--) {
    const j = (Math.random() * (i + 1)) | 0;
    [perm[i], perm[j]] = [perm[j], perm[i]];
  }
  for (let i = 0; i < 256; i++) perm[i + 256] = perm[i];

  const fade = t => t * t * t * (t * (t * 6 - 15) + 10);
  const grad = (hash, x, y) => {
    const u = (hash & 1) ? x : -x;
    const v = (hash & 2) ? y : -y;
    return u + v;
  };
  const noise = (x, y) => {
    const X = Math.floor(x) & 255, Y = Math.floor(y) & 255;
    x -= Math.floor(x); y -= Math.floor(y);
    const u = fade(x), v = fade(y);
    const a = perm[X] + Y, b = perm[X + 1] + Y;
    return THREE.MathUtils.lerp(
      THREE.MathUtils.lerp(grad(perm[a], x, y),     grad(perm[b], x - 1, y),     u),
      THREE.MathUtils.lerp(grad(perm[a + 1], x, y - 1), grad(perm[b + 1], x - 1, y - 1), u),
      v
    );
  };
  const fbm = (x, y) => {
    let sum = 0, amp = 0.5, freq = 1;
    for (let o = 0; o < 5; o++) {
      sum += noise(x * freq, y * freq) * amp;
      amp *= 0.5; freq *= 2;
    }
    return sum;
  };

  const img = ctx.getImageData(0, 0, w, h);
  const px = img.data;
  for (let y = 0; y < h; y++) {
    const lat = (y / h - 0.5) * Math.PI;         // -pi/2 .. pi/2
    for (let x = 0; x < w; x++) {
      const lon = (x / w) * Math.PI * 2;
      // sample noise on the sphere so the seam at lon 0/2pi matches up
      const nx = Math.cos(lon) * Math.cos(lat) * 2.2;
      const ny = Math.sin(lon) * Math.cos(lat) * 2.2;
      const n = fbm(nx + 11.3, ny + 4.7) + fbm(nx * 2.7 - 3.1, ny * 2.7 + 9.4) * 0.35;
      const i = (y * w + x) * 4;

      if (n > 0.06) {
        const elev = Math.min(1, (n - 0.06) * 2.4);
        const cold = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (Math.abs(lat) - 0.95) * 2.6));
        const dry  = Math.max(0, 1 - Math.abs(Math.abs(lat) - 0.42) * 5);
        let r = 46 + elev * 120 + dry * 80;
        let g = 84 + elev * 78  - dry * 10;
        let b = 38 + elev * 62  - dry * 10;
        r = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(r, 236, cold);
        g = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(g, 240, cold);
        b = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(b, 246, cold);
        px[i] = r; px[i + 1] = g; px[i + 2] = b;
      } else if (n > 0.02) {                      // shallow shelf
        px[i]     = 30 + n * 120;
        px[i + 1] = 96 + n * 120;
        px[i + 2] = 140;
      }
    }
  }
  ctx.putImageData(img, 0, 0);

  const tex = new THREE.CanvasTexture(c);
  tex.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
  tex.wrapS = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
  return tex;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------- earth
const RADIUS = 1;
const tilt = new THREE.Group();
tilt.rotation.z = THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(23.4);
scene.add(tilt);

const earthMat = new THREE.MeshPhongMaterial({
  map: load('earth_atmos_2048.jpg', THREE.SRGBColorSpace, () => {
    earthMat.map = proceduralEarth();
    earthMat.specularMap = null;
    earthMat.normalMap = null;
    earthMat.needsUpdate = true;
  }),
  specularMap: load('earth_specular_2048.jpg'),
  normalMap: load('earth_normal_2048.jpg'),
  normalScale: new THREE.Vector2(0.85, 0.85),
  specular: new THREE.Color(0x2b3f57),
  shininess: 18
});

const earth = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(RADIUS, 96, 64), earthMat);
tilt.add(earth);

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------- clouds
const cloudMat = new THREE.MeshPhongMaterial({
  map: load('earth_clouds_1024.png', THREE.SRGBColorSpace, () => {
    clouds.visible = false;
  }),
  transparent: true,
  opacity: 0.45,
  depthWrite: false,
  blending: THREE.NormalBlending
});
const clouds = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(RADIUS * 1.012, 96, 64), cloudMat);
tilt.add(clouds);

// ----------------------------------------------------------------- atmosphere
// Backside shell with a fresnel falloff — cheap, convincing limb glow.
const atmosphere = new THREE.Mesh(
  new THREE.SphereGeometry(RADIUS * 1.16, 96, 64),
  new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
    transparent: true,
    side: THREE.BackSide,
    blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending,
    depthWrite: false,
    uniforms: { uSun: { value: sun.position.clone().normalize() } },
    vertexShader: `
      varying vec3 vNormal;
      varying vec3 vWorldNormal;
      void main() {
        vNormal = normalize(normalMatrix * normal);
        vWorldNormal = normalize(mat3(modelMatrix) * normal);
        gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position, 1.0);
      }
    `,
    fragmentShader: `
      uniform vec3 uSun;
      varying vec3 vNormal;
      varying vec3 vWorldNormal;
      void main() {
        float rim = pow(clamp(1.0 - abs(vNormal.z), 0.0, 1.0), 3.2);
        float lit = smoothstep(-0.45, 0.55, dot(vWorldNormal, uSun));
        vec3 col = mix(vec3(0.16, 0.36, 0.85), vec3(0.45, 0.68, 1.0), lit);
        gl_FragColor = vec4(col, rim * (0.18 + lit * 0.85));
      }
    `
  })
);
scene.add(atmosphere);

**The actual bug:** my version pointed at `unpkg.com/three@0.160.0/examples/textures/...`, which returns **404** — the npm `three` package doesn't ship the example textures. Every texture load failed, so it silently fell back to the blobby procedural canvas globe. Your reference file used `cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/mrdoob/three.js@r160/...`, the GitHub mirror, which does serve them. I confirmed with curl:

```
404      unpkg .../earth_atmos_2048.jpg
200 512K jsdelivr .../earth_atmos_2048.jpg
200 223K earth_specular_2048.jpg
200 336K earth_normal_2048.jpg
200 260K earth_clouds_1024.png
200 734K earth_lights_2048.png
```
